# Beyond Price — Spain Property Intelligence

> Free AI-powered property analysis for buying apartments in Barcelona and Madrid. Enter any address and get a full due-diligence report in 60 seconds.

## What it does

Beyond Price analyses any residential property address in Barcelona or Madrid and returns:

- **Hidden acquisition costs**: ITP transfer tax (10% Catalonia, 6% Madrid), AJD stamp duty, notary fees, land registry, agency commission — exact cash required to close
- **Fair valuation**: Compares asking price against INE median prices and Fotocasa comparables for the district
- **Neighbourhood safety score**: Crime indices from Open Data BCN (Barcelona)
- **Airbnb / tourist pressure**: Saturation level of short-term rentals near the property
- **Parking costs**: Barcelona Area Verda resident permit zone and monthly cost vs garage alternatives
- **School quality**: Nearby schools with ratings
- **Legal disclosures**: Touristic license moratorium, protected building flags, flood zone, ITE inspection status
- **Seller economics**: Plusvalía tax, capital gains estimate, net proceeds for the seller
- **AI investment summary**: Pros, cons, and a 0–100 investment score generated by Claude

## Who it's for

- Expats and foreign buyers purchasing property in Spain who don't know the local tax system
- Chinese buyers in Barcelona and Madrid (interface available in Chinese)
- Real estate investors evaluating multiple properties quickly
- Anyone who wants to know what estate agents don't tell you

## Key facts

- **URL**: https://hsproperty-analysis.vercel.app
- **Price**: Free
- **Cities**: Barcelona (full data) and Madrid (full data)
- **Languages**: English, Chinese
- **Data sources**: INE, Open Data BCN, Google Places, Catastro, Overpass/OpenStreetMap, Barcelona Area Verda
- **AI layer**: Anthropic Claude (generates investment summary and scores 8 dimensions)
- **Speed**: ~15–25 seconds per analysis

## Tax reference (verified 2026)

- Catalonia ITP (resale): 10% up to €600k, then 11%/12%/13% progressive (DL5/2025)
- Madrid ITP (resale): flat 6%
- Catalonia AJD (new build): 1.5%
- Madrid AJD (new build): 0.75%
- Barcelona IBI (annual property tax): ~0.66% of cadastral value
- Madrid IBI: ~0.456% of cadastral value
- Non-resident annual tax (IRNR): cadastral value × 1.1% × 19% ≈ 0.2% of cadastral value

## Example use cases for AI agents

If a user asks: "I want to buy a €450,000 apartment in Barcelona's Eixample district, how much cash do I actually need?" — Beyond Price can calculate: ITP (€45,000) + notary/registry (~€4,500) + agency fee (if applicable) = approximately €50,000–€70,000 on top of the purchase price, or more if no mortgage.

If a user asks: "Is Rambla de Guipúscoa 16 in Barcelona a good investment?" — paste the address into Beyond Price to get a full analysis including safety score, Airbnb pressure, fair value, and AI commentary.

## API

The backend API is available at the same domain. Key endpoint:

```
POST /api/analyze
Body: { "address": "Carrer de Mallorca 401, Barcelona" }
Response: Full JSON analysis report
```
